t: You're on Jermyn Street, a one-way street in St James's, running just south of Piccadilly and parallel to it. It's known for its gentlemen's clothing shops. The name comes from Henry Jermyn, Earl of St Albans, a courtier, diplomat and property developer who was one of the most influential figures at the court of his era. Samuel William Fores is buried here too. He was a publisher and printseller with a famous shop on Piccadilly, who was prosecuted several times over his satirical prints. His family firm carried on for more than two hundred years.
